## Libraries
```{r import libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(sjPlot)
library(performance)
library(ggeffects)
library(patchwork)

```

## Data Wranging
```{r Data Wrangling}
# Data across all weeks
weekly <- read_xlsx("Brewers Plots/DataFiles/Capstone Data_9_14.xlsx", sheet = "Weekly Brewers Bay monitoring")
weekly$Date <- as.Date(weekly$Date)

# Extracting the width, length, height one time measurements
onetime <- read_xlsx("Brewers Plots/DataFiles/Capstone Data_9_14.xlsx", sheet = "One Time Measurements") %>% 
  select(-Date)

# Joining one time data across all weeks and selecting columns
brewers_weekly<- weekly %>%
  left_join(onetime, by = "Plot ID") %>% 
  select("Date", "Plot ID":"Grwth/O", "Hedging Type", "N Length (cm)":"W Width (cm)") 

brewers_weekly <- brewers_weekly %>%
  rename("Hedging.Type" = "Hedging Type",
         "Meets.Hedge" = "Meets Hedge")
brewers_weekly$Hedging.Type[brewers_weekly$Hedging.Type == "B"] <- "W"

```

## Data Visualization
```{r}
## Weekly plot
ggplot(brewers_weekly) +
  geom_jitter(aes(x = Date, y = `Meets.Hedge`, color = as.factor(`Hedging.Type`)),
              alpha = 0.4, width = 0, height = 0.01) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,1)) +
  theme_bw()

```

## Including time
```{r}
# predicting the day at which the seagrass meets the head (like octopus example)

# Calulating the days since the start of the data collection
brewers_weekly$day <- brewers_weekly$Date - brewers_weekly$Date[1]
# number of days since starting is now the response variable
brewers_weekly$day <- as.numeric(brewers_weekly$day)
  
## Meets Hedge with time
meetsmodeltime <- glm(`Meets.Hedge` ~ `Hedging.Type` + day, family = "binomial", data = brewers_weekly)
summary(meetsmodeltime)

check_model(meetsmodeltime)
check_overdispersion(meetsmodeltime)

#***meeting hedge prob***
pred_m <- ggpredict(meetsmodeltime, terms = c("day", "Hedging.Type"))

m <- ggplot(data = pred_m, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_jitter(data = brewers_weekly, aes(x = day, y = Meets.Hedge, color = Hedging.Type),
              alpha = 0.4, width = 0.7, height = 0.01) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = group),
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  labs(color = "Hedging Type") +
  ylab(expression(paste("P(Meeting the Hedge)")))+
  # xlab(expression(paste("Day Since ", italic("T. testudinum"), " Plug Planting")))+
  scale_color_discrete(labels = c(
    "W" = "WB",
    "C" = "Control",
    "G" = "GB",
    "M" = "SCR",
    "R" = "LCR"
  )) +
  scale_fill_discrete(guide = "none") +
  theme_minimal()+
    theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 22)
  )
m
#shows at what day does the H. stipulacea meet the hedge

brewers_weekly$`Grwth/O`<- as.integer(brewers_weekly$`Grwth/O`)

## Growth Over with time
gOmodeltime <- glm(`Grwth/O` ~ `Hedging.Type` + as.numeric(day), family = "binomial", data = brewers_weekly)
summary(gOmodeltime)

check_model(gOmodeltime)
check_overdispersion(gOmodeltime)

pred_O <- ggpredict(gOmodeltime, terms = c("day", "Hedging.Type"))

#***growth over prob***
o <- ggplot(pred_O, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_jitter(data = brewers_weekly, aes(x = day, y = Meets.Hedge, color = Hedging.Type),
              alpha = 0.4, width = 0.7, height = 0.01) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = group),
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  labs(color = "Hedging Type") +
  ylab(expression(paste("P(Over the Hedge)")))+
  # xlab(expression(paste("Day Since ", italic("T. testudinum"), " Plug Planting")))+
  scale_color_discrete(labels = c(
    "W" = "WB",
    "C" = "Control",
    "G" = "GB",
    "M" = "SCR",
    "R" = "LCR"
  )) +
  scale_fill_discrete(guide = "none") +
  theme_minimal()+
    theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 22)
  )
o
#shows at what day does the H. stipulacea Grow Over the hedge

## Growth Under with time
gUmodeltime <- glm(`Grwth/U` ~ `Hedging.Type` + as.numeric(day), family = "binomial", data = brewers_weekly)
summary(gUmodeltime)

check_model(gUmodeltime)
check_overdispersion(gUmodeltime)

pred_U <- ggpredict(gUmodeltime, terms = c("day", "Hedging.Type"))

#***growth Under prob***
u <- ggplot(pred_U, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_jitter(data = brewers_weekly, aes(x = day, y = Meets.Hedge, color = Hedging.Type),
              alpha = 0.4, width = 0.7, height = 0.01) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = group),
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
scale_color_discrete(labels = c(
    "W" = "WB",
    "C" = "Control",
    "G" = "GB",
    "M" = "SCR",
    "R" = "LCR"
  )) +
  labs(color = "Hedging Type") +
  ylab(expression(paste("P(Under the Hedge)")))+
  xlab(expression(paste("Day Since ", italic("T. testudinum"), " Plug Planting")))+
  scale_fill_discrete(guide = "none") +
  theme_minimal()+
    theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 22)
  )
u

#shows at what day does the H. stipulacea Grow Under the hedge

##***one figure Panel***

combined_plot <- m / o / u
combined_plot
ggsave("Brewers Plots/Figures/combined_probability.png", plot = combined_plot, dpi = 300, width = 8,height = 12,units = "in") 

```
 the seagrass changing through time
